schema:
CREATE TABLE "applicant" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "applicant_code" INTEGER UNIQUE, "applicant_name" TEXT);

CREATE TABLE "evaluation" ("id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "applicant_code" INTEGER, "score" INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY ("applicant_code") REFERENCES "applicant" ("applicant_code"));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT t1.applicant_name FROM applicant AS t1 INNER JOIN evaluation AS t2 ON t1.applicant_code = t2.applicant_code WHERE t2.score = (SELECT MAX(score) FROM evaluation)
